programme.title: Strange World S1 - "Exploding Toads"

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Phenomenal"

programme.title: Wonder S1 - "Sensory Tricks"

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Sustainable Leaders"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll visit a facility in Reno that makes biofuel for United Airlines aircraft.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Slovenia"

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Animal Rescue"

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Invasive Planet"
programme.desc: In this episode, we see a few different ways researchers are fighting invasive plants, animals, and materials in native habitats.

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Flame Thower"

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Tank"

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "Da Vinci Chariot"

programme.title: The Re-Inventors S2 - "4 Armed Catapult"
programme.desc: The 13th century catapult must be great, especially when it has 4 spinning arms.

programme.title: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Look Who’s Lifting Now"
programme.desc: Apprentice Eden tackles her first big lift. Dan and Francis work a hydro dam, Brad and Nathan assemble a gantry, and J.P. moves steel beams.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Feeding The Billions"
programme.desc: We explore potential new strategies to satisfy the growing food demand, from restaurants growing potatoes in the air to jellyfish as a potential sustainable meat alternative.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "The People's Voice"
programme.desc: We meet grassroots movements in US and UK who are fighting for a political intervention to stop climate change.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Plastic Into Products"
programme.desc: We meet enviro-entrepreneurs who recycle plastic waste to produce a large variety of items from fishing boats to coffee cups.

programme.title: Earthrise S1 - "Rewilding Patagonia"
programme.desc: We visit Patagonia National Park to find out how it became one of the biggest conservation projects in history.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "Nature Inspires The Future"
programme.desc: Host Chuck Pell sees how humpback whales are showing designers how to save millions in energy costs.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050 S2 - "The Future Of Warfare"
programme.desc: Join host Chuck Pell as he plays videos games that are shaping modern battle plans.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Italia Wild"
programme.desc: Italy is one of the very few nations in the world that regularly gets three major extreme natural phenomena – volcanos, flooding, and avalanches. The most recent eruption was in November 2006.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Kenya"
programme.desc: Mt.Elgon is an 14,000 foot volcano in eastern Kenya. We propose a safari/ascent of the dormant volcano. Here’s the first kicker:High on the the flanks of the volcano is Kitum Cave – a cave created by the most unique form of erosion – Elephant Erosion

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "By Camel to Timbuktu"
programme.desc: It is time for “Angry Planet” to do a serious desert episode. What better place to do it than this fabled city in the middle of the mighty Sahara Desert.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "The Power of Water"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll see ways that water is the backbone of energy and resources in different areas across the planet.

programme.title: Xploration Awesome Planet S6 - "Teens Making An Impact"
programme.desc: In this episode, we’ll meet teens that are working to make the planet a better place with innovative ideas and lots of hard work.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Indian Monsoon"
programme.desc: In June of next year we plan to intercept the Monsoon as it hits southern India and makes its way north along the western shore past Goa and Mumbai up to Delhi.This most famous of torrential rainy seasons drops as much as 40 feet of water.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Java - Land of Fire"
programme.desc: The most notorious volcanic explosion in history came from the small island of Krakatoa, off the coast of Java. The tiny island was pulverized and the giant explosion was felt half way around the world. Java is at the heart of the Ring of Fire.

programme.title: Angry Planet S2 - "Iceland"
programme.desc: Northern Iceland has many of the wild features that we love – volcanoes, glaciers, avalanches, mudslides, big waves, and extreme marine weather. All that – plus weird red and green lights dancing around in the winter sky!

programme.title: Destruction Decoded S1 - "Megafloods"
programme.desc: Witness the devastating destructive power unleashed by planet earth’s most valuable resource – water.

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Antonov AN-2"
programme.desc: We take you flying in this classic Russian workhorse. Anthony gets hands-on with the revolutionary iPad tablet to show some of the most popular aviation tools available. A look at the future of commercial aviation… but who will be there to fly these things?

programme.title: The Aviators S2 - "Cessna 195"
programme.desc: Kurtis takes us up in the aircraft that’s a crowd favorite wherever it he takes it. We spend some time with an ever-growing group of people who use their planes as campers and for one week a year, the tower at Oshkosh’s Wittman Regional Airport becomes the busiest on the planet.

programme.title: The Aviators S3 - "WWII Pilot Training - T-6"
programme.desc: Kurtis earn his wings in a T-6 warbird at Stallion 51 Flight Operations in Kissimmee, FL!

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "A Satellite’s Eye View"
programme.desc: Join host Emily Calandrelli as we look at satellites that will provide us with instant images of our planet and bring high-speed internet to every human on Earth.

programme.title: Xploration Outer Space S3 - "The Art of Space"
programme.desc: Four artists display their unique methods of illustrating the mysterious frontier of outer space. Host, Emily Calandrelli tries spray painting as well.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "The Last Crusade of Indiana Terry"

The duo will travel down to Uvalde, TX to visit Drivetanks.com to see if a tank round will topple over a car, and if a 9mm round can travel through three Germans.

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Equalizing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry and Larry will test 3 scenes from Denzel Washington’s Equalizer films. Can Terry be as cool as Denzel and use propane tanks and a microwave to create an explosion, use a staple gun to take out the bad guy, or create a scenario where a flash bang will ignite a room full of baking flour?

programme.title: Hollywood Weapons: Fact or Fiction? S4 - "Silencing Terry"
programme.desc: Terry wants to demonstrate how Hollywood has used different objects to silence a gunshot, and he and Larry will take to the range to see which one is the most qualified to act as a silencer. Terry also has a sit-down with Joey Zasa from Godfather 3 (Joe Mantegna) to discuss what he thinks of Hollywood’s adaptation of the silencer.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Shane Chen"
programme.desc: Shane Chen is an inventor. Or to use his own words, he is a “tinkerer” – a fellow who makes a living from molding mechanisms into quirky creations.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Massoud Hassani"
programme.desc: Massoud Hassani has developed the mine kafon drone that could find and get rid of the landmines, fast and cheap.

programme.title: Power & S2 - "Denis Boivin"
programme.desc: Canadian engineer Denis Boivin has invented the track n Go, which makes it possible for any 4x4 vehicle to become a snowmobile in 15 minutes.

programme.title: The New Frontier S4 - "Set Course for the Heart of the Sun"
programme.desc: NASA’S Parker Solar Probe Mission is on its way and will be followed by Europe’s Solar probe Mission. No spacecraft have traveled so fast or so close to a star before. It is hoped to reveal the source of the solar winds that effect us on Earth.

programme.title: Made in Britain S1 - "Ribena and Tyrells"
programme.desc: Taking a nostalgic journey to rediscover two of his childhood favourites, Lord Prescott visits the Ribena factory to see how their famous blackcurrant squash is made, using 90% of the UK's blackcurrant crop. In Herefordshire, he explores the Tyrrells crisp factory to learn how a small farm-based business turns homegrown potatoes into gourmet crisps.

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci IQ"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. On average, how deep are our oceans? What was the largest earthquake ever measured on the Richter scale? What is an apex predator?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci World"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. What’s the hairiest animal on the planet? What is the most common cause of the waves in the ocean? Why does the surface of Mars look red?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Pop Sci Test"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Do you know what causes an avalanche? What is the lightest element in the universe, hydrogen or helium? What was the main purpose of the Space Shuttle Program?

programme.title: Sci Q S1 - "Sci Q’s and A’s"
programme.desc: Fast-paced, pop-science show that will test your science I.Q. Where’s the hottest place on earth? Where’s the coldest place? Is it true that a jellyfish has neither a heart nor brain? And what exactly is a Supernova?

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Claudia Hughes"
programme.desc: Thom travels to the UK to track down real life rubber girl Claudia Hughes, a contortionist whose extraordinary flexibility defies human physiology.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Tom Sietas"
programme.desc: Thom travels to the UK to track down Aquaman Tom Sietas, who can hold his breath submerged for a death defying 22 minutes.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "Anthony Kelly"
programme.desc: Thom’s in the UK to track down Anthony Kelly; a man whose world record breaking reflexes are rumoured to be superhuman.

programme.title: Extraordinary Humans S2 - "George Aldrich"
programme.desc: Thom meets a man with a superhuman sense of smell; George Aldrich is Nasa’s Chief Sniffer; employed to detect problems before they become a hazard in space.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Resurrecting Tasmanian Tigers"
programme.desc: Wiped off the face of the Earth by humans nearly a century ago, geneticists are now working on ressurecting the enigmatic Tasmanian Tiger.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Shark Family Tree"
programme.desc: Great white sharks are one of the most feared predators on Earth, and yet we know very little about them. Science is now revealing the mysteries of this perfect predator through evolutionary biology.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Recovering From Extinction"
programme.desc: How long does it take for life to rebound after a major mass extiction? Scientists in Svalbard dig through fossil clues for surprising revelations abour our Earth's history.

programme.title: Breakthrough S1 - "Miami Beach Underwater"
programme.desc: As scientific studies confirm sea level changes throught the globe, major coastal cities like Miami are now fighting back against these rising tides, before it's too late. Parts of Miami Beach are under serious threat, with major economic dangers.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Recycled Science"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler shows you how to take your recycled junk and turn it into the coolest do-it-yourself science.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Bet You Can’t"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler reveals amazing science tricks that will have you saying to your friends, “I bet you can’t do that!”

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "PVC Science"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler presents fun do-it-yourself inventions that you can create at home, all made from PVC pipes.

programme.title: Xploration DIY Sci S6 - "Science Of Suds"
programme.desc: Steve Spangler creates crazy ways to make bubbles at the Children’s Museum of Denver at Marsico Campus.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Search for Japan's Lost Supersub"

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Path to the Pros"
programme.desc: What does it take to become a professional tennis player? Both on and off the court preparations help build the streght of character and focused mind to take on the challenges of a sport that demands precision and superior athleticism.

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "The Wright Brothers: Bravery"
programme.desc: Just over 100 years ago, a pair of brothers looked at the sky and changed the world. They designed, built and flew the most ridiculous of inventions. How did two bicycle mechanics manage to succeed where the others had failed?

programme.title: Bright Now S1 - "Chungungo: The World's Smallest Otter"
programme.desc: Meet a family of Chungungos, the world's mysterious, smallest otter. Living along the untamed coast of the southern Pacific Ocean, these furry, intelligent, and adorable creatures make their home in the wild of Chile.

programme.title: Secrets of the Brain S2 - "Twins"
programme.desc: Dr Jack Lewis is on a mission to understand why identical twins are such an asset to science from development in the womb onwards.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "Newcastle"
programme.desc: Taking down eight giant towers will take expert precision, planning & explosives. It’s imperative none of them fall in the wrong direction or fire any debris.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "City of London"
programme.desc: An asbestos ridden 1960s building in the crowded City of London is to be demolished to make way for a new hotel.

programme.title: The Demolition Man S1 - "The Best of Part 2"
programme.desc: Brendan Moar looks back at the most interesting and dramatic moments that he’s encountered as The Demolition Man.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter"
programme.desc: We have rare acces to BAE Systems. At their research centre in Kent, they're developing the futuristic Striker II helmet giving fighter pilots the edge in aerial combat

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Live Fire Exercises, Body Armor, Armored Vehicle AJAX"
programme.desc: Discover the latest innovations in kit and equipment at the key military and security exhibition in the UK; Lockheed Martin's heat-seeking Indago drone; and the tech spec on the British Army's new armored vehicle, the AJAX.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Battlefield 3-D, Drone Tech, 2-man Orcasub"
programme.desc: The innovative combination of 3D video and drone technology gives infantry soldiers an accurate battlefield picture. Northrop Grumman's top European executive shares their predictions on how technology will change the way we fight.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "USS Zumwalt, Tank Training, Special Forces Vehicle"
programme.desc: We reveal eye-witness intelligence on the USS Zumwalt, America's ultra-hi tech, four billion dollar guided missile destroyer. Learn more about the British firm who've developed Minerva, an ingenious, low-cost but realistic tank simulator.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Typhoon Fighter, Combat Medics, USS Dwight D. Eisenhower"
programme.desc: The Military Tech Show captures the moment when BAE System's radical new pilot helmet, the Striker II, goes operational for the first time in a Typhoon fighter aircraft; how interactive technology is helping train military combat medics.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Spear 3 Missile, Battlefield VR, Spy Drones"
programme.desc: European manufacturer MBDA give a hands-on demonstration of their state-of-the-art missile, the Spear 3. Learn how scientists are using a virtual reality headset to see the battlefield in a revealing new way.

programme.title: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Radar Tech, Imperial War Museum, Land Mine Detection"
programme.desc: We have rare access to the German Aerospace Center outside Munich where scientists are using new forms of radar for surveillance and detecting land mines.

programme.title: War Factories S3 - "Rolls Royce - The engine that won the War"
programme.desc: The Rolls-Royce Merlin engine powered iconic WWII aircraft and became vital to Allied air power after early failures and major development.

programme.title: War Factories S3 - "Enterprise: Rise of the Aircraft carrier"
programme.desc: USS Enterprise was the US Navy’s most decorated ship, shaping WWII’s Pacific War and showing how American industrial power supported victory.

programme.title: War Factories S3 - "Skoda: the factory that fought back"
programme.desc: In 1939 Nazi Germany seized Czechoslovakia’s Škoda Works.But under A.Göring’s covert resistance, the factory was used to undermine the Nazi war effort.

programme.title: War Factories S3 - "Ferdinand Porsche: Nazi muscle machines"
programme.desc: Ferdinand Porsche designed major Nazi vehicles including the Tiger tank and VW Kübelwagen, but many impractical designs strained Germany’s war effort.

programme.title: War Factories S3 - "Opel: The truck that ran the Blitzkrieg"
programme.desc: Modern warfare depended on logistics, and the Opel Blitz truck powered Nazi Blitzkrieg—despite being owned by an American company.
